project_info.theme: Pocket styling shot for YSL beauty essentials
project_info.color_palette: Black denim, baby pink, rose gold, chrome silver, soft nude skin

main_subject.detail: A black denim pocket contains a round quilted pink YSL compact with a gold logo and a shimmering silver YSL Loveshine-style lip product, while a hand with glossy black nails slides the lip product into the pocket.
main_subject.style: Luxury fashion-accessory beauty still life, tactile close-up, editorial product styling

items: Top Left: Dark black denim texture with visible seam stitching
Top Right: Fingers with glossy black nails pinching the silver lip product cap
Bottom Left: Pocket edge framing a quilted pink compact with gold YSL logo
Bottom Right: Frosted pink shimmering lip product with reflective silver cap and YSL monogram band
Center/Background: Tight fashion-detail crop of the pocket opening and products arranged as luxury on-the-go essentials

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Tactile fabric contrast, glossy metal reflections, soft skin highlights, intimate fashion-close-up mood
